title: Reduced Step-Size Optimization with Expanded Thickness Bounds
scientific_hypothesis: Reducing the optimizer thickness update scale factor by 50% while increasing upper thickness bounds by 45 nm will prevent overshoot into destructive interference regimes and allow deeper layers to expand optical path length toward full constructive reinforcement, improving target score beyond 0.9829.
design_principle: Gradient-based thickness optimization with constrained perturbation magnitude prevents large jumps that degrade spectral performance; expanded bounds eliminate artificial clipping on thick layers.
proposed_topology: 24-layer alternating TiO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate, starting with TiO2 at air interface
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness bounds expanded to allow deeper optical path
theory_basis: Quarter-wave baseline initialization provides physically motivated starting point for local optimization
Needle optimization iteratively adjusts thin layers to minimize merit function for multi-wavelength targets
expected_advantages: Smaller step size prevents destructive interference overshoot
Expanded bounds allow full constructive reinforcement in deep layers
Should improve upon iteration_05 best score of 0.9829
known_risks: Smaller step size may require more iterations to converge
Expanded bounds may increase search space complexity
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer alternating TiO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate at 45 degrees incidence. Initialize thicknesses from iteration_05 best candidate: [45.47, 66.26, 100.01, 115.66, 54.39, 104.87, 69.43, 114.90, 69.98, 102.33, 64.45, 116.99, 56.99, 108.17, 51.15, 83.29, 45.85, 81.30, 51.66, 104.20, 56.85, 92.37, 39.98, 156.38] nm. Apply gradient thickness optimization with step size reduced by 50% relative to previous round. Set upper thickness bound to 200 nm (45 nm increase from 155 nm baseline). Evaluate unpolarized plane wave illumination across 450-650 nm (high reflectance target) and 700-1000 nm (high transmittance target). Score candidates by weighted spectral performance with crosstalk minimization. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 450-650 nm, 700-1000 nm. soft objectives: high reflectance in 450-650 nm; high transmittance in 700-1000 nm; minimized crosstalk between bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 450-650 nm; reflectance in 700-1000 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 24 layers.
revision_reason: Per feedback directives: reduce optimizer thickness update scale factor by 50% to constrain perturbation within ±12% of resonance bandwidth, and increase upper thickness bound by 45 nm to eliminate artificial clipping on deepest layers.
